headline: Global Oil Supermajors Balance Robust Profits With Capital Spending Restraint
summary: International oil supermajors are positioned to post another strong quarter of earnings supported by Middle East tensions, while electing to keep capital expenditure disciplined despite windfall tax discussions.
why: Capital allocation by major oil producers impacts dividend yields, share buybacks, and long-term supply capacity across global energy markets.

impacts.name: Integrated Oil & Gas
impacts.why: Disciplined capital spending amid elevated earnings supports shareholder returns and free cash flow generation.
